name: R3 Wind Harp of Pure Healing

system.description:
When using the "Serenade to the Goddess" skill, this item increases the HP recovery amount by +10

Purrified Eye  [Core Material] (50G)

Simple Instrument (60G)

Black Ring (90G)

3x [Magic Catalyst 3] (25G)

Construction (105G)

A wind-powered keyboard organ decorated with four small statues of goddesses. The goddess statue has a magical fan that rotates by catching even the slightest breeze. By supplying wind to the linked power sources, the organ produces a rich tone. It seems that some of the more legendary models can change the tone, but their existence has not yet been confirmed.
